title: Tivoli Gardens
description: A historic amusement park in Copenhagen. Tivoli Gardens features thrilling rides, beautiful gardens, and live performances. It’s a must-visit spot that blends nostalgia with modern entertainment.
transportation: Accessible via Copenhagen Central Station.

title: National Museum of Denmark
description: Denmark’s largest cultural and historical museum. It houses artifacts from the Stone Age to modern times, offering deep insight into Danish heritage. Interactive exhibits make it great for all ages.
transportation: Located near the City Hall Square.

title: Nyhavn
description: A picturesque 17th-century waterfront lined with colorful townhouses, historic wooden ships, and lively restaurants. Nyhavn is a perfect spot for a leisurely stroll or a canal tour. It's one of Copenhagen's most iconic and photographed locations.
transportation: Accessible via Metro M1/M2 to Kongens Nytorv station.

title: The Little Mermaid
description: A bronze statue inspired by Hans Christian Andersen's fairy tale, perched on a rock by the waterside at Langelinie promenade. Despite its modest size, it's a symbol of Copenhagen and a popular tourist attraction. The statue has been a fixture since 1913.
transportation: Reachable by bus or a short walk from Østerport Station.

title: Rosenborg Castle
description: A Renaissance castle built in the early 17th century, housing the Danish crown jewels and royal regalia. The castle offers a glimpse into royal history with its well-preserved rooms and artifacts. Surrounded by the King's Garden, it's a peaceful retreat in the city.
transportation: Accessible via Nørreport Station, served by Metro and S-train lines.

title: Round Tower
description: A 17th-century tower known for its unique spiral ramp leading to an observatory at the top. It offers panoramic views of Copenhagen and hosts exhibitions in its library hall. The tower is a blend of historical architecture and scientific heritage.
transportation: Located near Nørreport Station, accessible via Metro and S-train.

title: National Gallery of Denmark
description: Denmark's largest art museum, featuring collections from the Renaissance to contemporary art. The museum offers free general admission and hosts various temporary exhibitions. It's a cultural hub for art enthusiasts.
transportation: Accessible via Nørreport Station, served by Metro and S-train lines.

title: Church of Our Saviour
description: Famous for its corkscrew-shaped spire with an external winding staircase that offers panoramic city views. The church is an architectural masterpiece and a significant religious site. Climbing the tower is a popular activity for visitors.
transportation: Accessible via Christianshavn Metro Station.
working_hours: Church: Daily 11:00–15:30; Tower: Seasonal hours, booking required

title: Kronborg Castle
description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, known as the setting of Shakespeare's Hamlet. The castle features Renaissance architecture and offers insights into Danish royal history. Located in Helsingør, it's a popular day trip from Copenhagen.
transportation: Approximately 45 minutes by train from Copenhagen Central Station to Helsingør Station.

title: Ny Carlsberg Glyptotek
description: An art museum housing a vast collection of sculptures and paintings, including works by Rodin and French Impressionists. The museum combines classical architecture with modern design. It's a serene space for art and history lovers.
transportation: Located near Tivoli Gardens, accessible via Central Station.

title: Copenhagen Zoo
description: One of the oldest zoos in Europe, home to over 3,000 animals across various species. The zoo features a modern elephant house designed by renowned architect Norman Foster. It's an educational and fun destination for families.
transportation: Accessible via bus lines or a short walk from Frederiksberg Metro Station.

title: The Workers Museum
description: Dedicated to the history of the Danish working class, showcasing everyday life from the 19th century to present. The museum offers interactive exhibits and historical reconstructions. It's located in a historic building near Nørreport Station.
transportation: Accessible via Nørreport Station, served by Metro and S-train lines.

title: Louisiana Museum of Modern Art
description: A world-renowned museum located along the coast north of Copenhagen. It features an extensive collection of modern and contemporary art in a beautiful setting that blends architecture and landscape. The museum also hosts rotating exhibitions and has a scenic sculpture park.
transportation: Take the train from Copenhagen Central Station to Humlebæk Station, then walk 10 minutes.

title: Hija de Sanchez
description: Run by ex-Noma chef Rosio Sanchez, this taqueria serves authentic Mexican tacos using imported masa and local ingredients. It's a favorite for those seeking bold flavors without breaking the bank.
transportation: Multiple locations, including Torvehallerne near Nørreport Station.

title: Gasoline Grill
description: Known for its juicy, organic beef burgers served in a soft potato bun. Despite its humble beginnings at a gas station, it's now a citywide favorite for quality fast food.
transportation: Original location near Kongens Nytorv Station; multiple outlets across the city.

title: Madglad
description: A cozy eatery in Vesterbro offering daily specials with fresh salads and homemade bread. It's a communal dining experience that feels like home.
transportation: Accessible via Metro M3 to Enghave Plads Station.

title: Absalon
description: A community center in a former church offering communal dinners at long tables. The menu changes daily, focusing on comfort food and fostering connections among diners.
transportation: Located in Vesterbro, accessible via Metro M3 to Enghave Plads Station.
working_hours: Dinner served daily at 18:00; ticket purchase required in advance

title: Eiffel Bar
description: A classic dive bar in Christianshavn known for its cheap drinks and 80s music. It's a cozy spot with a laid-back atmosphere.
transportation: Accessible via Metro M1/M2 to Christianshavn Station.

title: Heidi’s Bier Bar
description: An après-ski themed bar offering a wide selection of international and local brews. Known for its lively atmosphere and table dancing.
transportation: Located in the city center, near Rådhuspladsen Station.

title: Floss Bar
description: An underground bar with alternative music and affordable drinks. Features pool tables and a vibrant crowd.
transportation: Located in the city center, near Nørreport Station.

title: Kind of Blue
description: A cozy jazz bar tucked away in Copenhagen's Latin Quarter. Kind of Blue offers a relaxing atmosphere with live music, candlelight, and a fine selection of cocktails and beers. It’s perfect for an intimate night out or a laid-back evening with friends.
transportation: Close to Nørreport Station.
working_hours: Tuesday–Saturday: 17:00–01:00; Closed on Sundays and Mondays

title: Lulu
description: A charming café and bakery located in the heart of Copenhagen. Lulu is known for its fresh sourdough bread, seasonal dishes, and welcoming vibe. It’s a great spot for breakfast, brunch, or a relaxed lunch without breaking the bank.
transportation: Located in Vesterbro, accessible via Metro M3 to Enghave Plads Station.

title: Vækst
description: Vækst offers Nordic cuisine in a stylish greenhouse-inspired setting filled with plants and natural light. The menu focuses on fresh vegetables, grilled meats, and seasonal ingredients, all presented beautifully. It’s an affordable spot for a modern Danish dining experience.
transportation: Located near Nørreport Station, within walking distance.

title: Ruby Bar
description: Ruby Bar is a stylish and intimate cocktail bar located in the heart of Copenhagen. Known for its expertly crafted cocktails, elegant atmosphere, and exceptional service, Ruby offers a refined experience for cocktail enthusiasts. The bar is set in a cozy, yet sophisticated setting, making it perfect for a night out or a relaxed evening with friends.
transportation: Located in the city center, accessible via Metro M3 to Nørreport Station or a short walk from Kongens Nytorv.

title: Curfew Cocktail Bar
description: Curfew is a luxurious, speakeasy-style cocktail bar located in the Vesterbro district of Copenhagen. Known for its vintage ambiance and intimate setting, Curfew specializes in expertly crafted cocktails, many of which are inspired by classic recipes with modern twists. The bar offers a hidden entrance, adding an element of mystery and exclusivity to the experience. Curfew provides a refined atmosphere perfect for cocktail connoisseurs and those looking for an intimate night out.
transportation: Located at Vesterbrogade 20, 1620 København V. Accessible via Metro M1/M2 to Vesterbro Station or a short walk from Tivoli Gardens.
working_hours: Tuesday–Thursday: 18:00–02:00; Friday–Saturday: 17:00–03:00; Sunday: 19:00–02:00; Closed on Mondays

title: Taphouse Copenhagen
description: Taphouse is a popular craft beer bar in the heart of Copenhagen, offering an impressive selection of over 60 beers on tap. The bar has a relaxed yet vibrant atmosphere, making it a perfect spot for beer lovers to explore local and international brews. Whether you’re a casual drinker or a connoisseur, Taphouse provides a great variety of flavors and styles. It’s also known for its excellent service and cozy setting, making it a favorite hangout for both locals and tourists.
transportation: Located in the city center, accessible via Metro M3 to Nørreport Station or a short walk from Strøget.

title: Maple Casual Dining
description: Maple Casual Dining is a cozy and welcoming restaurant in Vesterbro offering homemade European-inspired cuisine. The focus is on quality ingredients, warm hospitality, and a relaxed atmosphere. It's a great place for a casual dinner, date night, or gathering with friends.
transportation: Located at Vesterbrogade 24, 1620 Copenhagen V. Accessible via Metro M3 to Enghave Plads Station or a short walk from Copenhagen Central Station.

title: The Olive Kitchen & Bar
description: The Olive Kitchen & Bar is a contemporary and stylish restaurant in the heart of Copenhagen. Specializing in Mediterranean-inspired dishes with a modern twist, The Olive offers a refined dining experience in a relaxed and elegant atmosphere. Whether you're looking for a casual meal or a special occasion, this restaurant promises excellent service and delicious food.
transportation: Located at Gothersgade 47, 1123 Copenhagen K. Accessible via Metro M1 to Kongens Nytorv Station or a short walk from Nørreport Station.

title: Schønnemann
description: Schønnemann is one of Copenhagen's oldest and most iconic restaurants, known for its authentic Danish smørrebrød (open-faced sandwiches). The restaurant offers a traditional experience, serving high-quality, locally sourced ingredients in a warm and historic atmosphere. Perfect for those looking to try classic Danish cuisine.
transportation: Located at Hauser Plads 16, 1127 Copenhagen K. Accessible via Metro M1 to Kongens Nytorv Station or a short walk from Nørreport Station.
